releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.5.0 OptiRouter Deep AI Engine & Battery Health SMART ACPI Overhaul:
- OptiRouter AI v4 Dynamic Gaming Engine: Deep binary inspection (Unreal Engine 4/5, Unity, Source, RE Engine, CryEngine, DLSS, Vulkan, DirectX 12, EasyAntiCheat) dynamically routes games to NVIDIA RTX 4060 dGPU and productivity/browsers to AMD Radeon iGPU.
- Multi-Drive Library Auto-Scanner: Parses Steam libraryfolders.vdf across all drives, Epic Games, Riot, GOG, and Xbox Game Pass.
- Autonomous Real-Time Game Mode: Elevates process priority to AboveNormal, sets VoltMaster EPP=0 for minimum frame latency, and primes cooling.
- Battery Health Fixed: Multi-class ACPI WMI parsing (BatteryStaticData + BatteryFullChargedCapacity + BatteryCycleCount) provides instant wear level % and cycle count diagnostics.
